analysis_type: Follow-up exploration after the overall 15-minute result; specified before calculating destination summaries and the 60-minute comparison
cohort: Keep the original minimum-10 airline/destination/month matching and the same flights for both thresholds
route_interval_family: Both thresholds for every destination meeting the coverage rules; family size is 2 times the supported destination count
route_interval_adjustment: Bonferroni t critical value; existing conditional weekly CR1 variance
limited_coverage_policy: Retain descriptive point estimates and counts; suppress displayed intervals and direction classifications
report_examples: Eight destinations with the largest retained flight counts, selected without using outcome rates

tableau_sources.overall_comparison_2025.csv: One row per delay threshold; overall full-year matched comparison
tableau_sources.destination_comparison_2025.csv: One row per destination and threshold; fixed full-year scope
tableau_sources.comparison_pairs_2025.csv: One row per matched airline/destination/month/window; both threshold numerators are columns

tableau_filter_policy: Use precomputed summaries only at their documented full-year scope. Use ratio-of-sums from the pair table for whole-month, airline, or destination filters; those filtered point estimates do not inherit the full-year summary intervals.
